card.name: Inside long drug names and 'concomitant'
card.fires_on: The pole responds to the last piece of a split-up drug name such as sulfonamide, imiquimod or phenobarbital. It also responds to the middle of 'concomitant' in interaction advice.

modes.description: The middle piece of 'concomitant' in advice to avoid use together with another drug.
